text:
Sam: Heads-up — AcmePay asked if we can move a slice of their high-volume, non-PII spot traffic into reserved capacity to avoid preemptions. They want a migration runbook + pilot.
Anya: Do they have an SLA target? 99.9 vs 99.99 will change commit sizing.
Sam: They care about p95 latency consistency more than absolute availability. Aim is to avoid token drops and bursty tails during auctions.
Liz: We can offer a 'soft reserve' migration path: pin sessions into reserved shards during window and spill back afterwards. Need clear admission criteria and billing mapping.
Jeff: Oncall concern: preempt notifications must be at least 5m. Also autoscale cooldowns need tuning to avoid thrashing during the handoff.
Michael: Important note — model KV cache warmup means session moves can spike p95 by 2-5x until prewarm completes. Need prewarm step in the runbook.
Sam: Runbook should include: trigger conditions, handshake API (customer -> ops), session pinning approach, prewarm steps, rollback criteria, and telemetry to watch.
Anya: Could we offer temporary burst credits instead of full migration? Might be a lower-cost solution for them.
Liz: We have a burst-credit primitive but mapping to reserved quotas and how it decays over time is messy. Requires billing + contract signoff.
Karen: AcmePay legal wants explicit start/stop windows and a clear price delta for reserve vs spot. I can negotiate a 2-week pilot window.
Sam: Proposed launch criteria for pilot: 2 weeks running, p95 within agreed threshold, <1% preemptions, end-to-end observability and billing flow validated.
Jeff: Ops checklist: ensure k8s drain hooks are idempotent, eviction logs structured (tenant_id, pool_from, pool_to), alert on failure_rate > 0.5%, fallback route available.
Michael: Autoscale policy suggestion: prefer slightly slower scale-down to preserve cache, faster scale-up only during controlled migration bursts.
Liz: I'll prototype an autoscale profile named `migration-friendly` — includes `min_replicas=1` per tenant shard, `prewarm=enabled`, and `cooldown=6m`.
Sam: Action items: Liz - runbook draft by EOD Fri; Jeff - add oncall alerts + eviction logging; Michael - write prewarm best-practices; Karen - confirm pilot contract terms with AcmePay.
Jeff: :thumbsup: I'll also add an integration test that simulates moving 5k concurrent sessions between pools.
Anya: Add a feature-flag to force fallback to hosted/compatible model variants if migration introduces quality regressions.
Sam: Also prepare a cost-delta template (reserved vs spot) we can attach to the pilot agreement.
Opsbot: Deploybot: created branch `migration-runbook/1761234567` in infra/runbooks.
Karen: I'll set up kickoff with AcmePay for next Tue 10am PST.
Liz: Added initial TODOs in the runbook; will open PR when draft is ready.
Sam: Thanks — quick sync Thu 10am to review full runbook before kickoff. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
Jeff: Noted. I'll throw a short chaos test at this on Monday night to validate eviction handling.
Anya: One more: add a post-pilot retrospective checklist (metrics to capture + customer feedback questions).
Sam: Good call. I'll add that to the runbook spec.
Karen: I'll bring the pilot pricing and legal redlines to the kickoff.
Liz: PR incoming by Fri noon.
Sam: Great work — keeping this small and reversible is the priority.
